$comment: A plain description of Twinslip's MCP server. It is a local stdio server that runs on the user's computer, so there is no remote endpoint and no .well-known server card (those describe HTTP servers). Details: https://graychar2425-blip.github.io/twinslip-site/agents.md
name: twinslip
title: Twinslip
description: Lets an AI agent report the purchases it makes to the user's local expense ledger, prove its connection without spending anything, read its own spending and budget, and finish setup for the user. Add and read only: it can't confirm, delete or hide anything, and receipts it finds are kept as evidence, never as verification.

install.note: Run from the Twinslip folder. Never asks anything; each agent app gets its own agent, named after it. Then restart the app and call get_setup. Verified end to end with Claude Code; Claude Desktop, Codex and the ChatGPT desktop app, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Zed, Windsurf and Devin Desktop are configured by setup but not verified end to end. Other agents can use the CLI or the local webhook (untested).

args: <claude-desktop | claude-code | cursor | windsurf | devin | codex | vscode | gemini | zed>

tools.name: record_receipt
tools.title: Record a receipt found in email

tools.name: record_bank_alert
tools.title: Record a purchase alert from the user's bank

tools.name: finish_sweep
tools.title: Say an email sweep is finished

tools.name: get_spend
tools.title: How much have the agents spent

tools.name: get_setup
tools.title: What is left to set up

tools.name: test_capture
tools.title: Prove the connection without spending anything

prompts.name: bank_alert_sweep
prompts.title: Sweep my email for bank purchase alerts

prompts.name: receipt_sweep
prompts.title: Sweep my email for agent receipts

authentication.note: Local only. The agent's identity comes from the config line setup wrote (--agent-key for the app, or --agent with a name), never from the model.
